clauses.quote: The Teacher, in consultation with the Supervisor, shall decide whether the project is to be undertaken.

Each School shall establish a Morning Block Team (MBT), which shall consist of the Supervisor (or her/his designee), the Building Representative (or her/his designee), the Instructional Coach, all department and grade level chairs, and other Teachers as designated by the Supervisor or the Building Representative.
The MBT shall develop a Morning Block plan and a monthly calendar of the use of the Morning Block that shall be provided to all Teachers.
The Morning Block plan shall be available, upon request, to both DCPS and the WTU.
